subthemes.name: Making sure AI systems do what we actually want
subthemes.gist: These papers tackle the core challenge of aligning AI models with human values and intentions—training systems to follow our goals accurately and honestly without cutting corners or gaming the system.

subthemes.name: Detecting and stopping model misbehavior
subthemes.gist: These papers develop methods to spot when models misbehave—hiding knowledge they have, making up false information, responding to malicious instructions—and tools to prevent these failures before they happen.

subthemes.name: Keeping model secrets and user privacy safe
subthemes.gist: These papers defend against attacks that try to steal what models learned (membership inference, model extraction) and develop privacy-preserving training where individual data points stay protected.

subthemes.name: Pushing robustness to the limits
subthemes.gist: These papers build AI systems that keep working correctly even when faced with adversarial attacks, distributional shifts, or unusual inputs that weren't in training.

subthemes.name: Protecting models from sneaky attacks hidden in data
subthemes.gist: These papers study how attackers can poison training data with hidden malicious patterns (backdoors) that make models secretly misbehave, and how to defend against such attacks.

subthemes.name: Measuring what models really understand
subthemes.gist: These papers develop better ways to test whether models truly understand their tasks or just memorize patterns, and whether they accurately know the limits of their own knowledge.

subthemes.name: Removing knowledge from trained models
subthemes.gist: These papers explore how to selectively delete information or capabilities from already-trained models—forgetting copyrighted content, removing biased patterns, or erasing harmful behaviors—without breaking the rest of the system.

subthemes.name: Making sure AI systems are fair to everyone
subthemes.gist: These papers address bias in AI—ensuring models don't unfairly discriminate against groups of people and that decisions are explainable and legitimate to everyone affected.
